subject: Startups
title: Burn Rate and Runway
description: A short lesson to help you apply Burn Rate and Runway.

hook.text: A startup spends $2 million per month and has $12 million in the bank. It has six months to live. That's runway.

buildup.text: Burn rate is how fast a startup spends cash. Runway is how many months of burn the bank balance covers.

discovery.text: Smart founders maintain 12-18 months of runway. Anything less means fundraising panic and desperate decisions.

twist.text: In 2022, many unicorns had under 6 months of runway after years of heavy spending. Mass layoffs followed.

climax.text: Startup graveyards are full of companies that ran out of cash with a great product. Cash is oxygen.

punchline.text: Runway isn't a metric. It's a countdown clock.

quiz.question: What is 'runway' in startup finance?
options: Months of cash remaining at the current burn rate
Distance from headquarters to the airport
